c1_ma2_scaling_poiseuille_bodyforce.note: unidirectional flow with periodic streamwise BC => rho is uniform (measured max|rho-1| = 1e-13) => the third-order equilibrium error terms vanish identically and the profile error is Ma-independent

c4_acoustic_filter.implemented: density-mode temporal low pass (momentum-preserving); not a Mach preconditioner
c4_acoustic_filter.note: No low-Mach preconditioner exists in this repository, so the campaign clause ('if preconditioning is implemented') is answered with a momentum-preserving density-mode temporal low pass instead: the acoustic band is suppressed below the 1e-5 target while the steady hydrodynamic (pressure) field, which is O(Ma^2) and physical, is left intact. The literal reading (total drho <= 1e-5) is unattainable in a pressure-driven channel and is reported separately.

acoustic_filter.implemented: density-mode temporal low pass (momentum-preserving); not a Mach preconditioner
acoustic_filter.pass_basis: acoustic-band amplitude of the whole record (contains the 1e-3 pulse); the post-transient half is at round-off for both branches, which is reported separately as drho_acoustic_amplitude_steady

ma_to_zero.protocol: least squares q = q0 + b Ma^2 (exponent fixed at 2)

mach_independence.ma_max_note: no measured Mach number satisfies the band against the Ma->0 limit

cylinder_instrument_validation.reason: the cylinder solver configuration does not reproduce the Re=100 reference hydrodynamics (see the per-run cd/st/cl checks); a Mach-independence verdict built on it would be unfounded
